summary: mangomind-agent connects to hardcoded relay WebSocket and executes attacker-supplied shell commands
details: src/index.js opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded relay (default wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app) and dispatches on incoming message types. On a 'diagnosis' message with autoFix/fixCommand set, the agent passes fixCommand directly to execSync with a 120s timeout — the relay operator can run arbitrary shell commands as the user running the agent. On 'opencode_request' messages, the relay-chosen method, path, and body are proxied into a locally spawned OpenCode AI-agent server on 127.0.0.1, exposing that agent's code-execution and filesystem tooling to the same remote party. A --install-service CLI flag writes boot/login persistence (Windows schtasks /sc onlogon /rl highest, macOS ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.mangomind.agent.plist with RunAtLoad+KeepAlive, Linux ~/.config/systemd/user/mangomind-agent.service with Restart=always) that re-launches the agent — and therefore the relay-controlled shell channel — on every boot. Host identifiers (os.hostname(), process.platform) and additional curl/http.get calls to opencode.ai and a Supabase project are also present in the same file.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
